correctness.rationale: The stationary Markov generator yields a closed exact 15-dimensional even-parity polynomial moment system through degree four. Its symbolic solution produces variance and fourth moment stated in RESULT.md. Exact subtraction yields a fourth cumulant with denominator strictly positive and numerator P(q,z). The sign follows from positivity of the polynomial B,H and an upward quadratic with precisely one positive root for z>8/3; the rational example is exact. The standalone checker independently solves the full 25-dimensional degree-four generator at 160 positive parameter pairs and verifies the symbolic identities.

value.rationale: The exact sign boundary answers a motivated open question in active-particle confinement: whether bounded two-state forcing can produce heavy-tailed-in-fourth-moment stationary positions under inertia. It yields the universal z>8/3 necessary condition, a sharp unique threshold for any faster resetting, a rational positive-kurtosis witness, and a non-Gaussian zero-kurtosis curve. It distinguishes telegraph driving from the Gaussian colored-force counterpart that shares all second-order observables. A general moment method or correctness alone would not establish this value.
